source.title: Lohrabi Pour, Ha, Nikpaik, 'An Ultra-Low Phase Noise Dual-Tank Oscillator Featuring Tank Impedance Scaling', IEEE TCAS-I 71(12):5657-5668, Dec 2024
source.figure: Fig. 10 (cross-coupled NMOS M1/M2, transformer Lp/Ls dual tank with Cs, Cp,f, Cp,s, varactor network, 4-bit capacitor bank, output + dummy buffers); element values Table III and Sec. IV
source.inputs: source/ (paper PDF, metrics.xlsx, operating_conditions.xlsx, pvt_corners.xlsx, FINAL_MAIN_SCHEMATIC.png = Fig. 10, main_schematic_2.png = Fig. 2; see source/ORIGIN.txt)
modifications: dut_benchmark.scs = final.scs plus documented changes (owner decision 2026-10-25, R06-Q1 option C; the export problems are reported to the dataset team): (1) capacitors from the Fig. 10 drawn values instead of the exporter's Table III totals: Cs 4.8 -> 3.8 pF, Cp,f 6.7 -> 2.25 pF per half, Cp,s 3.3 -> 1.1 pF; (2) series loss in every half-inductor branch, R = 2 pi f0 L / Q with f0 = 5.08 GHz (Sec. IV centre frequency) and Q = 17.4 (primary, DM Q) / 16.7 (secondary, CM Q), dependent on the inductance variables (the paper gives no other loss model); (3) varactors MVARL / MVARR nmos1 -> pmos1, gate on VARL/VARR and S = D = B on VC as drawn in Fig. 10: the drawing does not state the device type, the exported nmos1 does not tune below Vc = 1.2 V (92 fF flat, 30 fF at 1.5 V per 10u/1u) while pmos1 gives a monotonic 91 -> 46 fF over Vc 0.6-1.2 V (paper: the major Cmax/Cmin change lies in 0-1.2 V); (4) reference sizes for the elements the paper does not size (bank switches, buffers, control inverters) are curator values making them functional; (5) paper-fidelity fix 2026-10-27: inductor values LPL = LPR 145 pH -> 290 pH and LSL = LSR 129.5 pH -> 259 pH (the exporter halved the EM values of Fig. 10 / Sec. IV; the paper's tank model, Fig. 2(b) / Appendix A / Table III / Rp1 = 15.5 ohm, uses 290 / 259 pH as the drain-to-tap / gate-to-tap branch inductance; with the halved values the oscillating tank mode, the upper root of the paper's two differential roots with passive drain-to-gate gain Av ~ 2-3, lies at 8.5 GHz; with 290 / 259 pH it oscillates at 6.0 GHz and reproduces the paper's phase noise / FoM level). No other change; the bias-T / 50 ohm load and the start-up kick are testbench elements of recipe osc_pss_tune_bt_v1.

VSS.provenance: benchmark rule G3: ground pin without a family role driven by a 0 V source

VB_TANK.provenance: paper: Fig. 10 (Ls centre tap 0.6 V); sizing variable V_TANK

VDD_AUX.provenance: paper: Fig. 10 / Sec. IV (1.8 V varactor bias and buffer drain, via bias-T); a supply rail, fixed

VBUF.provenance: paper: Sec. IV (buffer gate bias 0.8 V); sizing variable V_BUF

VDD_DIG.provenance: curator_choice: digital supply of the cap-bank switch-control inverters; not stated in the paper, the paper's other rail (1.8 V)

S0.provenance: curator_choice: cap-bank code bit 0 (LSB); nominal code 8 = mid-range of the 16 states, S3 high; the extreme codes are the labelled conditions

S3.provenance: curator_choice: cap-bank code bit 3 (MSB, high in the nominal code 8)

op_check.note: G8 is checked at the DC equilibrium (osc_dc_v1 at VC = 0.6 V, kept for LC oscillators by the owner 2026-10-23). Excluded: the varactor devices MVARL/MVARR (gate at VDD_AUX through RBVAR, S = D = B on VC: accumulation/depletion varactors, Vds = 0 by construction), the cap-bank switches MS* (on/off by the code, Vds ~ 0 or off) and their control inverters MIN*/MIP* (digital: one device of each pair on, one off).

known_issues: Superseded finding (before the 2026-10-27 inductor fix): the circuit locked to the transformer's upper differential mode at 8.5 GHz. With LPL/LPR = 290 pH and LSL/LSR = 259 pH (paper-fidelity fix) it oscillates at 6.0 GHz at the Fig. 10 capacitors (the paper's analysed mode); a design with C_S about 7.3 pF reaches 4.9-5.45 GHz over the bank codes (paper 4.8-5.34 GHz). See onboarding_status.yaml paper_fidelity_2026_10_27.

The paper's results are measurements (power / PN / FoM) of the fabricated chip through the buffer into 50 ohm; the testbench measures the buffer outputs RFL / RFR (differential) with a 50 ohm bias-T load to VDD_AUX per output.
Metrics.xlsx lists FoM as a positive number (Eq. 25 sign convention); the flow's FoM is negative-better, so the targets are -193.2 etc.
